title: rfauto: automated RF/microwave simulation and tuning across HFSS, ADS and openEMS
description: rfauto is an open framework that automates RF/microwave simulation workflows across commercial (HFSS, ADS) and open (openEMS) solvers: template-driven model factories, surrogate-assisted optimization, multi-fidelity calibration with provenance, and an MCP tool surface for LLM agents. All physical numbers are produced by deterministic kernels only.
